name: smashlab
description: AI 羽毛球动作分析 — 纯前端（MediaPipe Pose + TensorFlow.js LSTM），可套壳为 Android / iOS / 桌面 App

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init SmashLab com.smashlab.app --webDir dist
scripts.make:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.make:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
